    FAQ

    Questions groups ask us

    Still unsure? Our group specialists answer 7 days a week.

    What's the minimum group size?

    6 travelers for standard packages, 10 for corporate retreats

    Can we customize the itinerary?

    Absolutely, every package is fully customizable after booking

    How does split payment work?

    Each member gets a unique payment link and can pay in installments

    What if someone drops out?

    Flexible cancellation up to 30 days before departure with full refund

    Do you handle flights?

    We can include flights or you can book your own

    Is travel insurance included?

    Optional travel insurance available at checkout
